content_areas.scale_name: TIMSS mathematics scale (centerpoint 500, SD 100) — inherited from TIMSS 2023

enrollment.note: Follow-up of TIMSS 2023 grade 4 (now 5) and grade 8 (now 9). Scores are on the TIMSS 2023 mathematics scale; there is no separate TIMSS-L standard setting.

MATHEMATICS.notes: Labels copied from timss-intl-2023 for the inherited International Benchmarks. IEA did not set separate TIMSS-L cut scores. proficient_from is the same placeholder as the 2023 record, not an IEA designation.

cutscores_provenance: No separate TIMSS-L cut scores. IEA TIMSS-L Progress Report (GA64, 2023): learning gains are measured on the TIMSS achievement scales; the 2023 grade 4/8 cohort is reassessed as grade 5/9 in 2024. MATHEMATICS International Benchmarks therefore inherit from timss-intl-2023 (Low 400 / Intermediate 475 / High 550 / Advanced 625; constant since TIMSS 2003). cutscores / cutscores_source are omitted so a consumer must resolve the linked administration rather than read a duplicated vector here.
